objective: sum over years and skill levels of redundant[year, skill] (total redundancies; the notebook's first objective)

skill.description: Skill level (the notebook's s1 = unskilled, s2 = semi-skilled, s3 = skilled)
skill.label: skill level

level.description: Rank of the skill level, 1 = least skilled; moving up a rank is retraining, moving down is downgrading. Ranks must differ Structural: orders the skill levels (retraining goes up, downgrading goes down); not a what-if input.
level.label: skill rank

current_strength.description: Workers employed at the start of the plan; all have at least one year of service
current_strength.label: current workforce

attrition_new.description: Share of the workers recruited in a year who leave within that first year
attrition_new.label: first-year attrition rate of recruits

attrition_experienced.description: Share of workers with at least one year of service who leave each year; also applied to workers retrained into this level
attrition_experienced.label: yearly attrition rate of experienced workers

year.description: Year of the plan, 1 = first year; years are planned in increasing order and year 1 starts from current_strength
year.label: year

required.description: Full-time workers needed in the year; a missing row means none are needed
required.label: manpower requirement

max_recruit.description: Most workers that can be recruited from outside in the year (upper bound on recruit); a missing row means no recruitment
max_recruit.label: recruitment limit

to_skill.description: Skill level the workers join (must differ from from_skill)
to_skill.label: to skill level

max_per_year.description: Fixed number of workers who can make this move each year. The yearly limit is max_per_year + max_share_of_target * workforce of to_skill in that year; both 0 forbids the move. A move with no row is unlimited and free
max_per_year.label: retraining places per year

max_share_of_target.description: Further allowance as a share of the to_skill workforce in the same year (0.25 = a quarter of it)
max_share_of_target.label: retraining limit as a share of the destination workforce

cost.description: Cost per worker making the move; counted in total_cost, not in the redundancy objective
cost.label: retraining cost per worker

redundancy_cost.description: Severance payment per worker made redundant; counted in total_cost
redundancy_cost.label: redundancy payment per worker

short_time_cost.description: Cost per worker on short-time working per year; counted in total_cost
short_time_cost.label: short-time working cost per worker

overmanning_cost.description: Cost per worker employed above the requirement per year; counted in total_cost
overmanning_cost.label: overmanning cost per worker

downgrade_attrition.description: Share of downgraded workers who leave the company in the year they are downgraded
downgrade_attrition.label: share of downgraded workers who leave

max_overmanned.description: Most workers employed above requirements in any year, all skill levels together
max_overmanned.label: overmanning allowance per year

max_short_time.description: Most workers of each skill level on short-time working in any year (upper bound on short_time)
max_short_time.label: short-time working limit per skill level

short_time_productivity.description: Output of a worker on short-time working relative to a full-time worker; each one leaves (1 - productivity) of a full-time worker's output to be covered
short_time_productivity.label: short-time worker productivity

decision_variables.recruit[year, skill]: workers recruited from outside (0..max_recruit; the notebook's Hire)
decision_variables.retrain[year, from_skill, to_skill]: workers retrained to a higher skill level (>= 0; the notebook's Train for upward moves)
decision_variables.downgrade[year, from_skill, to_skill]: workers downgraded to a lower skill level (>= 0; the notebook's Train for downward moves)
decision_variables.redundant[year, skill]: workers made redundant (>= 0; the notebook's Layoff)
decision_variables.short_time[year, skill]: workers on short-time working (0..max_short_time; the notebook's Part_time)
decision_variables.overmanned[year, skill]: workers employed above the requirement (>= 0; the notebook's Overmanned)
decision_variables.workforce[year, skill]: workers employed in the year after all flows (>= 0; the notebook's Available)
decision_variables.same_level[year, skill]: inert copies of the notebook's Train[year, s, s] columns: in no constraint, zero cost, not a measure; kept so the size matches the original

constraints.balance[year, skill]: workforce = (1 - attrition_experienced) * (last year's workforce, or current_strength in year 1) + (1 - attrition_new) * recruit + (1 - attrition_experienced) * retrained in + (1 - downgrade_attrition) * downgraded in - workers moved out - redundant
constraints.retraining_limit[year, from_skill, to_sk: move <= max_per_year + max_share_of_target * workforce[year, to_skill], one per retraining row and year
constraints.overmanning[year]: sum over skill levels of overmanned <= max_overmanned

retrain.label: workers retrained to a higher skill level

downgrade.label: workers downgraded to a lower skill level
